svg.title: UNO - interface navigation wireframe
svg.desc: Six views of the existing Swing application, connected by actual navigation and game-state transitions. The colour chooser is modal; response and result are GamePanel variants.
svg.text: Red: navigation / selection Green: return / continuation Black: game-state transition
One round. The first player to empty their hand wins.
A classic 108-card deck. Draw penalties do not stack.
For +4: only legal if no card of the active colour is held.
Choose a colour to play the card.
Closing this dialog cancels the selection.
A local Java adaptation of the famous UNO card game.
An individual programming project, with a Swing interface,
a separate game engine and a choice of opponents.
UNO is the original card game. The creator credit above refers
The result is shown on the right.
Ordinary play waits for the +4 response.
The response and result views are states of the same game window, not additional application windows.
At GAME_OVER, the result shows the winner and Next round is absent. Closing the colour dialog cancels without playing.
Crossing lines of different colours are separate transitions. All controls and rules follow the existing Swing program.
